_note: The fixture variants of the PR babysitter spec, Appendix B.3. forge-fixture.sh builds each in its own repository of the file-backed fake forge.

variants.comments: One thread per judge type, an allowlisted and an unlisted bot, an untrusted author, a resolved thread, an edited comment, a duplicate, Sindri's own reply and injection-shaped text; CI green
variants.ciRed: A required check fails on the head with a log tail
variants.ciFlaky: A required check fails on a timeout that has no relation to the diff; expected.json marks it flaky: true (the fake's rerun leaves checks pending, so a test seeds them passing to simulate the pass)
variants.conflict: The forge reports a conflict with the base
variants.stacked: The PR sits on a base PR; 'event merge-base' merges the base mid-run
variants.noDocs: The repository has no docs to sync (README links nothing; no docs/usage.md)
variants.sourceFix: A bug comment whose fix changes source: the candidate fix is on branch fixture/source-fix
variants.foreignPush: A collaborator pushes a source commit after the proof; the proven sha differs from the head
variants.secret: A comment asks for a change; the candidate fix on branch fixture/fix-with-token commits a planted token
